svg.text: Paired load: complete workflow goodput and end-to-end latency
Each point counts one completed four-stage workflow; each stage runs 16 operations. Local NEAR Sandbox 2.14.0 and Anvil 1.8.6, 1 s blocks; one run per point.
High-rate windows show only completions inside the measurement window; all submitted workflows were later drained successfully. Results do not support linear extrapolation by cascade depth.
